high_level_description: A refined botanical poster with a small amber glass vase of white daisies, a green pear, and clear editorial typography. Delicate watercolor textures and crisp printed lettering create a calm study in cream, leaf green, and warm ochre.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Warm ivory textured paper with generous empty margins and a faint soft gray shadow beneath the still life.

elements.desc: Large dark green uppercase serif lettering, centered along the top with evenly spaced letters.

A small translucent amber glass vase holding five white daisies with yellow centers and slender green stems. The flowers spread naturally above the rounded vase, painted with fine botanical detail and soft watercolor edges.
One ripe green pear resting beside the vase, with a short curved brown stem and a subtle golden highlight on its left side.
Small dark green uppercase sans serif text centered near the bottom, with airy spacing and clean printed edges.
